diagnosis.what_happened: Duplicate headers appeared after markdown concatenation, and LibreOffice inverted headings to the left margin.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Blind concatenation of markdown files without stripping unnumbered titles caused duplication. Overly restrictive regex left <w:jc w:val='right'/> intact, causing trailing-edge inversion under BiDi in LibreOffice.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Pre-assembly regex stripping of unnumbered stage titles. Universal removal of <w:jc> under <w:bidi w:val='1'/> across all headings.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Concatenation must not blindly stack self-contained headers. Explicit justification elements under BiDi confuse rendering engines like LibreOffice.

desired_behavior: 1) Implement pre-assembly regex stripping of stage titles. 2) Universally remove <w:jc> on all headings under BiDi contexts. 3) Enforce multi-margin verification in validator.
generalization: Text concatenation and RTL/BiDi formatting must preemptively handle independent artifact headers and explicit justification properties to prevent rendering inversion and structural duplication.
